scope: Read-only parameter-space diagnostic of the four completed seed-42 Phase-1 endpoints. It is not a selection metric, gate, causal mechanism proof, or multi-seed result, and it does not authorize any run.

calculation.effective_update: DeltaW_m = 2 * B_m * A_m for each module m.
calculation.frobenius_without_materialization: ||B A||_F^2 = trace((B^T B)(A A^T)); aggregate DeltaW norm is the square root of the sum over modules after multiplying by scaling squared.
calculation.a_drift: Global sqrt(sum_m ||A_final_m - A_initial_m||_F^2) divided by sqrt(sum_m ||A_initial_m||_F^2).
calculation.stable_rank: Per-module ||B A||_F^2 / ||B A||_2^2, averaged equally over 196 modules; scaling cancels.
calculation.update_cosine: Frobenius cosine after concatenating all module DeltaW tensors, computed exactly through rank-32 cross-Gram matrices.
calculation.initial_subspace_overlap: Per-module ||A_initial_1 A_initial_2^T||_F^2 / 32, averaged equally over modules; all initial rows passed the existing orthonormality verifier.
calculation.spot_check: For q_proj and down_proj in all four methods, explicit materialization of 2*B*A agreed with the rank-32 Frobenius formula within 9.1e-4 relative error in float32.

findings: Final effective-update magnitude does not explain evaluation quality: all four global DeltaW Frobenius norms lie in [0.13895, 0.14238], while Macro Avg@k lies in [0.31350, 0.37648]; I0 has the largest update norm but is not the best method.

The 5.6-5.9x larger logged gradient norms for signal-informed methods versus I0 do not produce larger final DeltaW. They reflect factor/subspace parameterization and optimization geometry rather than a monotone measure of training strength or generalization.
A changes by only 0.014-0.024 percent in global Frobenius norm. Despite lora_freeze_a=false, these 50-step runs behave approximately as fixed-A subspace training with learning concentrated in B.

The distribution of update magnitudes across the same 196 modules is nearly identical across methods (Pearson 0.9980-0.9995; magnitude-vector cosine above 0.9994), but full update directions are almost orthogonal (cosine 0.0145-0.0810). The main differentiator is direction within modules, not which modules receive more update norm.
Signal-informed methods have higher mean module stable rank than I0, but I16 has the highest value and the worst Macro Avg@k. Stable rank is descriptive and is not a performance proxy.
The nested initial-overlap pattern and low final-update cosine support a finite-step path-interaction interpretation, but do not identify a causal mechanism.
limitations: This is a post-hoc diagnostic on one training seed and cannot enter candidate selection or any fixed gate.
Parameter-space Frobenius geometry does not account for layer activation covariance, base-weight scale, or nonlinear function-space effects.

The four methods share training prompts and seed but generate different on-policy responses after their policies diverge; final update-direction differences are an outcome of both initialization and trajectory feedback.
A reusable checked analysis script should be added only after the active provenance-locked controller terminates if these numbers are used in the paper.
